title: R2 presigned URL fails when the host is swapped for the bucket custom domain or r2.dev
symptoms: A presigned GET or PUT returns 403 once the host is changed to the bucket custom domain
The same URL works on ACCOUNT_ID.r2.cloudflarestorage.com
Browser uploads fail with a CORS error until a bucket CORS policy is added
cause: Presigned URLs are only valid on the R2 S3 API endpoint and cannot be used with custom domains. Browser use also needs a CORS policy on the bucket.
fix: Generate and use presigned URLs against the S3 endpoint, add a CORS rule for your origin, and keep the custom domain for public reads.
affected: Cloudflare R2 S3 compatible API, as of October 2026
